name: GPT-DOUG Government / National Security AI Baseline
purpose: Engineering control map and evidence checklist. This is not a certification, authorization to operate, CMMC assessment, FedRAMP authorization, or classified-system approval.

profiles.name: NIST AI RMF 1.0
profiles.scope: AI risk governance, mapping, measurement, and management

profiles.name: NIST SP 800-218 SSDF + SP 800-218A
profiles.scope: Secure software development and AI-specific software development practices

profiles.name: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 / 800-53A
profiles.scope: Federal security/privacy controls and assessment procedures

profiles.name: NIST SP 800-171
profiles.scope: Protection of CUI in nonfederal systems; contract requirements control the applicable revision

profiles.name: DFARS 252.204-7012 / 7019 / 7020 / 7021 / 7025
profiles.scope: Defense-contract cybersecurity clauses; applicability is contract-specific

profiles.name: DoD Zero Trust Strategy
profiles.scope: Identity, device, application/workload, data, network/environment, automation/orchestration, visibility/analytics

profiles.name: FIPS 140-3
profiles.scope: Validated cryptographic modules for applicable federal use

profiles.name: FedRAMP + DoD Cloud SRG
profiles.scope: Cloud authorization baseline plus DoD impact-level requirements where applicable

profiles.name: National Security Systems Overlay
profiles.scope: CNSS/NSA/DoD requirements are mission, classification, and authorization-boundary specific

profiles.name: DoD Responsible AI
profiles.scope: Responsible, governed, accountable AI development and use

blocked_claims: Do not label a system CMMC certified unless a valid required assessment/status exists.
Do not label a system FedRAMP authorized unless the specific service/authorization exists.
Do not label a system FIPS compliant based only on use of AES/SHA; validation applies to cryptographic modules.
Do not claim ATO/RMF authorization without the responsible Authorizing Official decision.
Do not place classified information in this public repository or public demo environment.
